title: Motion tween: custom ease curve dialog (Bezier editor)
description: Flash 8 had a graphical custom ease dialog showing a Bezier curve for per-property easing (position, rotation, scale, color, filters). Currently only a -100 to 100 integer ease slider exists. Implement a modal dialog that lets users visually edit a cubic Bezier ease curve, storing it in the frame model's easing data. Cross-reference docs/02-timeline-and-animation.md for the ease data model.
